name: Kerros
source: Kerros is the King of the Sprites. He is beloved by his people and has extremely powerful magical abilities. He hasn't been seen since the untimely death of his daughter Effie, 400 years ago; his wife Solana has been ruling in his stead. He has always been a fair and just ruler although, anger often clouds his judgement, so it's best not to get on the wrong side of him. Many find it hard to believe that he was shy as a child, but as this was thousands of years ago, few are alive who remember it.
